name: Make a pose
objective: Makes a pose for the 3D OpenPose editor from joint positions - one body, or several (a list, one set of joints per body, each standing where its neck is given: side by side means different x) and keeps it in the pose bridge as a new scene file a person can open (Load Scene), change and save back. Positions are centimetres in the editor's world: y up from the floor, x to the viewer's right, z toward the viewer; a figure facing the viewer has its left side at +x. Only the bones' directions are taken (the body keeps its proportions); the body stands where the neck is given. A standing adult: nose about 155, neck 138, shoulders 138 at x -17 / +17, hips 92 at x -10 / +10, knees 52, ankles 10. Answers the file's name and the pose as the editor will show it, in words.

poser.about: the pose bridge the scene is kept in

name.label: File name
name.hint: A short name for the scene file; a name already there gets -2, -3 (nothing is replaced).

joints.label: Joint positions
joints.hint: A JSON object of joint name: [x, y, z] in centimetres, or a list of such objects for several bodies. Names: Nose, Neck, RShoulder, RElbow, RWrist, LShoulder, LElbow, LWrist, RHip, RKnee, RAnkle, LHip, LKnee, LAnkle (R: the figure's own right, at the viewer's left when it faces the viewer). A joint left out keeps the base pose's direction.

base.label: Start from (a pose in the bridge)
base.hint: (none): the editor's new body and camera. A pose file: its proportions, its camera and the directions of joints left out are kept - for changing a pose rather than making one.
